declarations.name: strokePath
declarations.description: A smooth path through the points: quadratic curves between the midpoints, so the line has no corners.

A box to sign in with a mouse, a pen or a finger, as in DocuSign or a delivery app's proof of receipt. Each stroke
is kept as the points the pointer passed through and drawn as a smooth SVG path, so the signature stays sharp at any
size and exports as vector or bitmap.

An empty pad shows a hint (`placeholder`, "Sign here" by default) over a baseline. **Undo** takes the last stroke
away and **Clear** empties the pad; `undo()` and `clear()` do the same from code. `strokes` holds the drawing (an
array of strokes, each an array of `[x, y]` points in CSS pixels) and can be set to show a saved signature. Export it
with `toSVG()`, `toDataURL(type?)` or `toBlob(type?)`.

It is a form control: under a `name` the form receives the signature as SVG markup, `required` asks for one, and it
takes part in `c2-form-field`. `readonly` shows a signature without letting it change.

A signature cannot be drawn from the keyboard, so a form that asks for one should accept a typed name as well.

members.name: strokes
members.description: The drawing: one array of `[x, y]` points per stroke, in CSS pixels. As an attribute, JSON. Not reflected.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the form receives the signature as SVG markup.

members.name: required
members.description: Asks for a signature: an empty pad is invalid.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Shows the signature without letting it change; the Undo and Clear buttons are hidden.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns the pad off; as for a disabled form control, the signature is not submitted.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the pad. Inside a `c2-form-field`, the field's label names it.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: The hint shown in an empty pad. Empty shows the built-in "Sign here".

members.name: current
members.description: The stroke being drawn, kept apart so a drag only redraws its own path.

members.name: isEmpty
members.description: True while the pad holds no strokes.

members.name: undo
members.description: Takes the last stroke away. Fires no event.

members.name: clear
members.description: Empties the pad. Fires no event.

members.name: toSVG
members.description: The signature as a standalone SVG document, the size of the pad, in the ink's colour and thickness.

members.name: toDataURL
members.description:
The signature as an image `data:` URL, drawn at the screen's pixel density. PNG and WebP keep a transparent
background; formats without transparency (JPEG) get a white one.

members.name: toBlob
members.description: The signature as an image `Blob`, like toDataURL.

members.name: ink
members.description: The ink as the pad draws it: the CSS variables resolved.

members.name: validStrokes
members.description: `strokes` with anything that is not a list of points dropped: the attribute and the property take any JSON.

members.name: pointOf
members.description: A pointer position in the pad's own CSS pixels, also under a scaled ancestor.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when the drawing changes: a stroke ends, or the user presses Undo or Clear. Read `strokes`, or `isEmpty`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired with `input`, once the drawing has changed. Not fired when `strokes` is set or `clear()` is called from code.
